faq.a: For smaller groups, Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and IVA. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other yachts are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can we bring our own music and decorations for the Pride party?
faq.a: Yes, you can connect your phone or laptop to the onboard sound system on most boats. Decorations like rainbow flags and balloons are welcome, but please avoid confetti or glitter that can pollute the sea. Let us know in advance so we can advise on setup.

faq.q: How many people can join a Pride boat party?
faq.a: Capacity varies by boat. The Astondoa 40 takes up to 9 guests, the Azimut 39 up to 11, and the Mangusta 80 up to 12. For larger groups, we can arrange multiple boats or a superyacht like the Ferretti 94 (12 pax). Check the fleet page for full details.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?

faq.q: What is the weather policy for Pride boat parties?

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2025 is set to be the biggest yet, and there's no better way to celebrate than on a private boat party departing from Puerto Banús. Skip the crowded beach clubs and take over your own deck, with the Mediterranean as your dance floor. Whether you're a group of friends or a solo traveller looking to join others, our fleet has options from €749 for 2 hours, all with skipper, drinks, and IVA included.

Why a Pride Boat Party in Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús is the heart of Marbella's glamour, and during Pride week it transforms into a rainbow-coloured hub of celebration. A boat party gives you freedom: swim in secluded coves, anchor near the Golden Mile, and enjoy panoramic views of La Concha mountain. You control the music, the pace, and the guest list – no queues, no noise limits, just you and the sea.

Our Fleet for Pride 2025

We have a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. For an intimate party of up to 9, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) is perfect. The Azimut 39 (12.5m) takes 11 guests. If you want more space and style, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a showstopper, and it comes with a free jet ski for extra fun.

For larger groups or special requests, contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on other yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86.

What's Included in Your Charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can bring your own food and drinks if you like, but we've got the basics covered.

Popular Routes During Pride Week

Most Pride charters head west towards Cala del Faro or east to Cala Cortés – both are calm anchorages with clear water. If you're feeling adventurous, cruise towards Estepona or even Sotogrande for a longer trip. Your skipper will tailor the route to your wishes, weather permitting.

How to Book Your Pride Boat Party

Booking is simple. Send us a message on WhatsApp with your preferred date, time, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link for the 50% deposit. The balance is due on the day. Popular slots – especially sunset and Saturday – go quickly, so book early.

Tips for an Unforgettable Pride Party

  • Bring a portable speaker if you want extra bass – most boats have AUX/Bluetooth.
  • Pack biodegradable sunscreen to protect the marine environment.
  • Wear comfortable shoes – decks can get slippery.
  • Let us know if you want a cake or special decorations – we can arrange.
  • Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús to board on time.
